summary: Verified the Merchant Registration 'Pay Joining Fee' order-creation fix. (1) Live curl to https://devapi.intownlocal.com/IN/payment/create-order with new payload {mobileNumber:'9876543210', amount:499, description, notes.type:'MERCHANT_JOINING'} returned HTTP 201 with internalOrderId=604, razorpayOrderId=order_TI4d9HVlucjyG7, keyId=rzp_test_SVoE9DrV8kRDqj, amount=499.00. (2) Frontend /register-merchant loads at 390x844 with 0 console errors. (3) [data-testid=pay-joining-fee-btn] visible with text 'Pay Joining Fee ₹499/-'. (4) Built dist bundle contains NO 'subscriptionPlan: MERCHANT_JOINING' string; the joining-fee POST body sends only {mobileNumber, amount, description, notes:{type:'MERCHANT_JOINING',...}} — no customerId, no subscriptionPlan. The residual 'customerId'+'subscriptionPlan' occurrences in the bundle belong to the (unrelated) plans/subscription code path where they are correct.
critical_code_review_comments: register-merchant.tsx is 2563 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules (form sections, payment logic, category picker) for maintainability.

handlePayJoiningFee correctly conforms to backend OpenAPI CreateOrderRequest: exactly one of customerId/mobileNumber (mobileNumber only), no subscriptionPlan sent, amount converted rupees->paise for Razorpay.
seed_data_creation: None. Live create-order call generated internalOrderId=604 on devapi (order created only, no payment captured).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Joining-fee create-order fix is verified end-to-end at API + code + rendered UI level. The button click cannot be end-to-end tested in preview without a full form fill + real Razorpay interaction. Any regression should re-check the payload shape in handlePayJoiningFee at /app/frontend/app/register-merchant.tsx (~lines 831-846).
rca of the issue: Original 400 was caused by frontend sending BOTH customerId (undefined/null for unregistered merchant) AND subscriptionPlan='MERCHANT_JOINING'. Backend CreateOrderRequest requires EXACTLY ONE of customerId|mobileNumber and subscriptionPlan is a strict enum (FREE_TRIAL/MONTHLY/QUARTERLY/SEMI_ANNUAL/ANNUAL) — 'MERCHANT_JOINING' is not a valid enum value. Fix: send mobileNumber only, drop subscriptionPlan, preserve joining-fee context via description + notes.type. Also fixed amount unit: backend returns rupees (499.00), Razorpay needs paise, so multiply by 100.
